speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: asked	the Minister for Home Affairs whether the Ministry will consider (i) putting a speed counter on heavy vehicles that are allowed to ferry passengers which will register each time the vehicle exceeds the speed limit for a prolonged period (ii) establishing a fine and demerit system for drivers caught speeding through these speed counters.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: This includes vehicles such as public or private buses, which ferry passengers.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: Such vehicle owners are required to send their vehicles for annual inspections at registered vehicle inspection centres to ensure that the speed limiters are in working condition.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: I just wish to clarify that what I am suggesting is what we already put in our military vehicles.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: You would realise that for the military vehicles, nobody is speeding, but most of us on the ground would see that a lot of the heavy vehicles are speeding, especially those carrying a lot of passengers in the back.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: If an accident happens, it is the loss of a lot of lives, including other commuters on the road.
